documents.title: Company overview report guide
documents.content: The company overview page loads /api/metrics/company_snapshot for sales, opportunities created, opportunities ran, and demo rate, then /api/metrics/company_trends from August 2025 when no territory or source filter is on. Snapshot responses are cached about 60 seconds. Trend responses are cached about 6 hours. Funnels are Company, Doors, Self Gen, Sweeper, Inbound, and 3PL. Sweeper is the Sweeper and Rehash pipelines. Phones is not its own funnel; Virtual still normalizes to Phones inside the company total. This document says how to retrieve those figures. It does not store sales totals.

documents.title: Observed GHL collections
documents.content: Observed collections include ghl_opportunities_v2, ghl_contacts_v2, ghl_pipelines_v2, and ghl_users_v2. Lead gen source custom field id observed in metric contracts: hd5QqHEOVSsPom5bJ32P. Appointment disposition custom field id: GYGpLKBPfMpiBqyU2ogQ. Sold date custom field id: P9oBjgbZjJdeE0OkBj9T. Sync frequency and access rules are not documented in this repository.

documents.title: Timezone observation
documents.content: On 2026-10-04 the data owner set the company reporting timezone to America/New_York. Sales, opportunities created, opportunities ran, and demo rate already force that zone. Company overview dates use America/New_York and do not take the default month from UTC. COPILOT_BILLING_TIMEZONE is not approved and must stay unset until the Google billing period is verified. This document remains DRAFT and is not company policy by itself.

documents.title: Company profile gap
documents.content: The product name in the overview title is Happy Solar. Pipeline comments mention Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, and Virtual. Team structure, markets, and responsibilities were not found as an approved document. Do not invent them.

documents.title: Lead-to-sale process gap
documents.content: Code identifies Sold and Sale Cancelled stage IDs and a sit disposition. A full lead-to-sale handoff narrative is not in the repository. Process answers stay disabled until an owner approves a process document.

documents.title: Goals and targets gap
documents.content: No approved sales target, quota, or goal amount was copied into this knowledge base. Do not infer targets from dashboards or from conversation text.
